title: Signature Dual-Checksum Pages
description: A Signature original: each page carries two independent checksums computed with different algorithms, so a single checksum collision or algorithm weakness cannot hide corruption. Both must agree or the page is quarantined. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Quorum-Verified Page Repair
description: A Signature original: the replacement page must match on two independent replicas before it is written, preventing a single bad replica from spreading its corruption. A lone dissenting replica is itself flagged for scrubbing. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Shadow-Flip Rebuild
description: A Signature original: the shadow index is checksummed page-by-page as it builds, and the flip only happens after a full verification pass plus a sample-query comparison against the old index. A bad rebuild never goes live. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Predictive Rebalancer
description: A Signature original: the rebalancer forecasts skew from insert patterns and rebalances ahead of the skew instead of after it. Forecast accuracy is tracked, and the system falls back to reactive mode if predictions degrade. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Crash-Proof Page Accounting
description: A Signature original: page allocation is journaled, so a crash can never create an orphan in the first place - recovery replays the journal and frees exactly the pages the crashed operation held. The sweep becomes a rarely-needed backstop. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Per-Page WAL Chains
description: A Signature original: each page keeps its own mini-WAL chain, so recovery replays only the pages that were dirty instead of scanning the whole log. Crash recovery time drops from minutes to seconds on large indices. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Priority-Ordered Scrubber
description: A Signature original: the scrubber orders pages by risk - age, error history, and disk SMART signals - instead of scanning blindly in order. The riskiest pages get checked first, catching rot where it is most likely. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Witnessed Convergence
description: A Signature original: each convergence round produces a signed witness of which branches were repaired and from where, creating an audit trail of every healing event. Disputes between replicas resolve by witness history. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Range-Pinned Partial Rebuild
description: A Signature original: the damaged range is pinned read-only during rebuild so concurrent writes queue cleanly instead of racing the repair. The pin is range-scoped, so the rest of the index stays fully writable. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Plan-Guarded Stats Refresh
description: A Signature original: new statistics are trial-run against the recent query log before going live, and the refresh rolls back automatically if plans get worse. Statistics can never silently degrade performance. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Fill-Factor Autotuner
description: A Signature original: the autotuner learns the update pattern per index region and sets fill factors accordingly - dense where data is stable, sparse where inserts churn. Compaction then has less work because pages were packed right the first time. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Triple-Root Commit
description: A Signature original: three root pointers rotate so there are always two known-good generations to fall back to, surviving even a crash during the crash-recovery itself. Recovery picks the newest fully committed root. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Geographically Split Roots
description: A Signature original: root copies live in different failure domains - separate disks, controllers, and power - so one hardware event cannot take all copies. Placement is verified at startup, not assumed. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Correlated-Anomaly Healing
description: A Signature original: anomalies are correlated across replicas before triggering, so a single slow disk does not cause a fleet-wide rebuild storm. Only anomalies seen on a quorum trigger healing. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Tamper-Evident Healing Ledger
description: A Signature original: the audit trail is hash-chained and anchored off-box, so even a compromised database cannot rewrite its own healing history. Recurring corruption patterns are flagged automatically from the chain. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.
